repair_notes: Eliminated 'Variable bound twice' by passing public keys as stable role arguments instead of recomputing pk(sk) inside each role.

Rewrote B's message reception to avoid fragile tuple destructuring on adversarial input: receive m directly, then use fst/snd projections and simple checks; this removes the unreachable state facts reported by the wellformedness checker.
Changed B's decryption handling to use fst/snd on the decrypted plaintext and a separate equality guard, removing the second fragile destructuring that caused an unreachable state.
Adjusted process block to invoke roles with the new stable public-key arguments, preserving all event names, arities, and argument semantics required by the target lemmas.
Kept executable, secret_A, secret_B, and secrecy_PFS_A lemmas unchanged; the repaired process now makes every continuation reachable and avoids stale-fact warnings.
